instructions: Rinse the rice until the water is mostly clear.
Add the measured rice and water to a small saucepan and bring to the boil.
Cover tightly, reduce to the lowest heat and cook for 10 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from the heat, leave covered for 10 minutes, then fluff gently with a fork.
Rinse the rice briefly and drain well.
Add the measured rice and water to a small saucepan and bring to the boil.
Cover tightly, reduce to the lowest heat and cook for 12 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from the heat, leave covered for 10 minutes, then fluff gently.
Put the couscous in a heatproof bowl and pour over the measured boiling liquid.
Cover tightly and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff thoroughly with a fork and season before serving.
Rinse the quinoa thoroughly in a fine sieve.
Add the quinoa and measured water to a saucepan and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer gently for about 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from the heat, rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Add the bulgur and measured liquid to a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook gently for 10-12 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Bring the measured liquid to a gentle simmer.
Pour in the polenta in a steady stream while whisking continuously.
Cook according to the packet type, stirring frequently, until thick and no longer gritty.
Season and finish with butter or cheese if the recipe calls for it.
Combine the oats and measured liquid in a saucepan.
Bring gently to a simmer, stirring regularly.
Cook for 4-6 minutes until creamy and the oats are tender.
Bring a generous saucepan of water to a rolling boil and salt it.
Add the pasta and stir well during the first minute so it does not stick.
Cook until al dente, using the packet time as a guide and tasting before draining.
Reserve a little pasta water before draining if the sauce may need loosening.
